title: Noise transition probabilities
statement: Let $\delta\in[0,1]$ and let $x,y\in\{−1,1\}$. Under coordinate noise with parameter $\rho=1-2\delta$, started at $x$, the probability of output $y$ is $1-\delta$ if $x=y$, and is $\delta$ otherwise.
